reviews.title: Punctual airline with limited network
reviews.text: This airline has been punctual when I have flown with them between Jinan and Taizhou/Luqiao. Flying time is normally also shorter than the scheduled time. You get a hot meal also in economy class
reviews.author: Stellan D

reviews.title: Excellent flight with first class service all around
reviews.text: I was concerned about flying on an airline that I hadn't heard of before but needed to make the trip--my fears were unfounded--the service was excellent all the way around, from the ticketing through the gate personnel--everyone was very professional and courteous --on board the almost new Boeing 787 the flight attendants were as good as anyone could be --attentive, professional and friendly----on time departure and early arrival --very enjoyable
reviews.author: Phil N
